text:
Sam L: I opened a docs PR to consolidate audit export guidance under Security & Compliance and added an "Export schema v2" example plus a small mapping table showing field pseudonymization. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1299
Priya (Legal): thanks. can we avoid 'TTL' wording? prefer 'retention period' in public docs. also need explicit note that retention may be limited by org policy and legal holds.
Nate (Eng-Runtime): please ensure the API examples use snake_case params: "retention_period_days". server enforces constraints and will return 403 if a requested retention exceeds org max.
Sam L: added a Python SDK snippet & a curl example below. let me know if the param names need tweaks:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit_exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"scope":"tenant:acme","retention_period_days":90,"schema_version":"v2"}'
```
```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
job = client.create_audit_export(scope="tenant:acme", retention_period_days=90, schema_version="v2")
print("job id:", job.id)
```
Leah (Security): add a short auditor checklist: exported fields list, whether PII is pseudonymized or redacted, encryption at rest (KMS) note, and retention enforcement timeline. also mention we rotate KMS keys per policy. use public KMS rotate doc link: https://redwood.com/docs/security/kms-rotation
Priya (Legal): can we add one concrete example where org policy overrides requested retention? helps auditors. e.g., request 400d but org max 365 -> response includes applied_retention_days.
Sam L: added applied_retention_days to the sample response and a JSONL sample for schema v2, plus a tiny note about legal holds blocking deletion. pushed changes.
docs-bot: PR #1299 opened by sam-l — reviewers requested: @priya-legal, @leah-security.
Nate (Eng-Runtime): small nit: in the sample export rows please include the pseudonymization flag "pii_state": "pseudonymized" or "raw" so ops can show auditors exactly what was exported.
Sam L: good call — included that. also added a short section: "When to use v2 schema" and a migration note for customers.
Priya (Legal): LGTM from legal side. no further wording changes needed.
Leah (Security): security ok, please replace internal KMS link with public one as discussed. :thumbsup:
Sam L: merging after CI passes. will add a release note to the compliance playbook and ping the customer success channel when published.
